stem:
Ajay notes that some buses in Delhi run on CNG, while cars fill petrol or diesel, and his kitchen uses LPG.

Which statement correctly groups the fuels?

options.text: Petrol, diesel and kerosene come from petroleum; petroleum, natural gas and coal are fossil fuels; CNG is compressed natural gas.
Wood and dung cakes are fossil fuels because they are burned for cooking.

teacher.key_rationale: Petroleum products and named fossil fuels follow the chapter grouping; CNG is compressed natural gas. A swaps LPG for natural gas; B reverses petroleum–petrol; D expands fossil fuels to all domestic fuels.
